messages:
Zoe (CS): CoralBay week0 recap: SOC paused the KMS policy approval until we can show signed TLS HEC handshakes + an end-to-end replay demonstrating zero-loss during a key rotation. They also insist on a documented 2yr retention proof. tagging @Aisha and @Tom — this is a potential renewal risk if not resolved this week.

Tom (SE): understood. i can produce a small end-to-end PoC: 1) replay last 48h from their presigned S3, 2) push to their staging HEC with our client cert, 3) provide a signed SHA256 fingerprint and the hec server cert chain for them to verify. need staging HEC creds/presigned URL.

Aisha (Security): will draft a rotation policy that supports a 72h overlap window (dual-key decrypt) and include a signed audit of delivery timestamps. also can provide a KMS policy template limiting encrypt/decrypt to their forwarder role + vpce. dropping a redacted snippet for review:
```
{
  "Version": "2012-10-17",
  "Statement": [
    {
      "Sid": "ForwarderOnly",
      "Effect": "Allow",
      "Principal": {"AWS": "arn:aws:iam::888777666555:role/coral-forwarder"},
      "Action": ["kms:Decrypt","kms:GenerateDataKey"],
      "Condition": {"StringEquals": {"aws:SourceVpc": "vpc-0cafe1234"}}
    }
  ]
}
```

Ken (Ops): ops notes from our internal dry-run: when HEC has short 5xx bursts we saw drops if checkpointing wasn't persisted. mitigation = longer checkpoint interval + idempotency keys + exponential backoff. runbook snippet:
```
# forwarder config
max_batch: 200
batch_timeout_ms: 2000
retries: 8
checkpoint_interval: 45s
idempotency: enabled
```

Tom (SE): i'll also include a verification script that computes pre-replay S3 object counts vs post-ingest splunk counts and emits a signed manifest file with sha256s of objects. example verification command i'll share in the playbook.

Riley (Renewals): marked as "watch" in CRM. i'll join the customer call after PoC results. if SOC still objects i'll request a C-suite join to unblock procurement.

ops-bot: Reminder: CoralBay week0 follow-up meeting scheduled 1818889200 (in 2h).

Zoe (CS): action items: 1) @Tom request presigned S3 + staging HEC creds from customer (EOD). 2) @Aisha post rotation policy + KMS snippet (tomorrow A.M.). 3) @Ken run replay to staging and publish the signed manifest + counts. @Riley i'll send a renewal note to the account after we have the manifest. i'll keep this thread live for SOC signoff and close once we have explicit acceptance.
